entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is that... an octopus? It's pretty damn[n]big. Do you think it's safe for us to[n]approach it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess it is just a painting, after all.[n]I'm sure we'll be okay...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Right. It could be a trap, after all.[n]Let's stay away from it, just to be safe.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, that was a valiant effort.
